questions.q: The fall armyworm, a recent serious pest of maize in Nigeria, is
questions.explanation: Spodoptera frugiperda arrived in Africa in 2016 and feeds in the whorl of maize.

questions.subject: Agricultural Science
questions.q: The use of predators and parasites to control pests is known as
questions.explanation: Ladybirds eat aphids; parasitic wasps were used against the cassava mealybug.

questions.subject: Agricultural Science
questions.q: Integrated Pest Management (IPM) involves
questions.A: the use of chemical pesticides alone
questions.B: combining several methods to keep pests below damaging levels
questions.C: eliminating every insect found on the farm
questions.D: banning all crop farming in the affected area
questions.explanation: IPM reduces cost, resistance and environmental damage.

questions.subject: Agricultural Science
questions.q: Which of the following is a pest of yam in the field and in storage?
questions.explanation: Yam beetles bore holes in tubers; control by dressing setts with insecticide and late planting.

questions.subject: Agricultural Science
questions.q: Nematodes that attack crop roots are best controlled by
questions.explanation: Fallowing, resistant varieties and soil solarisation also reduce nematode populations.

questions.subject: Agricultural Science
questions.q: A stored-grain trader found that maize kept in jute bags in a humid store was heavily infested with weevils, while maize dried and stored in sealed drums was not. The best explanation is that
questions.A: weevils cannot see inside dark drums
questions.B: airtight storage deprives insects of oxygen and moisture
questions.C: the smell of jute attracts weevils to the bags
questions.D: metal drums are much cooler than jute bags
questions.explanation: Hermetic storage (e.g. PICS bags and drums) is a cheap effective control for storage pests.

questions.subject: Agricultural Science
questions.q: Birds are serious pests of
questions.explanation: Quelea birds devastate ripening cereals; control by scaring, netting and timing of planting.

questions.subject: Agricultural Science
questions.q: An insecticide that is absorbed by the plant and kills sucking insects feeding on it is called
questions.explanation: Systemic insecticides such as dimethoate are translocated in the sap.

questions.subject: Agricultural Science
questions.q: One disadvantage of chemical pest control is that it
questions.A: is always cheap for small farmers to use
questions.B: kills useful insects and causes pollution and resistance
questions.C: requires no skill or training to apply
questions.D: never harms humans, livestock or wildlife
questions.explanation: Residues in food and water and the loss of natural enemies are major concerns.

questions.subject: Agricultural Science
questions.q: Termites damage crops and farm structures by
questions.explanation: Termites attack seedlings, cassava cuttings and wooden barns; control with insecticides and destruction of mounds.

questions.subject: Agricultural Science
questions.q: The science of raising, tending and managing forest trees is called
questions.explanation: Silviculture covers nursery practice, planting, thinning and harvesting of forest crops.

questions.subject: Agricultural Science
questions.q: Which of the following is a product of the forest?
questions.explanation: Forests also protect watersheds, prevent erosion, shelter wildlife and moderate climate.

questions.subject: Agricultural Science
questions.q: The felling of trees without replacement, leading to loss of forest cover, is called
questions.explanation: Deforestation causes erosion, loss of biodiversity, climate change and shortage of forest products.

questions.subject: Agricultural Science
questions.q: The planting of trees in an area where there was no forest before is called
questions.explanation: Reforestation is replanting where forest has been cut.

questions.subject: Agricultural Science
questions.q: Selective exploitation of a forest means
questions.A: clearing the whole forest at once
questions.B: felling only mature trees of chosen species
questions.explanation: Selective felling maintains continuous cover and yield.

questions.subject: Agricultural Science
questions.q: The felling of all the trees in an area of forest at once is called
questions.explanation: Clear felling is followed by replanting in plantation forestry.

questions.subject: Agricultural Science
questions.q: Which of the following trees is commonly planted in forest plantations in Nigeria for poles and pulpwood?
questions.explanation: Gmelina, teak (Tectona grandis) and eucalyptus are fast-growing plantation species.

questions.subject: Agricultural Science
questions.q: Taungya is a forestry practice in which
questions.A: food crops are grown among young plantation trees
questions.B: trees are felled selectively for timber
questions.C: the forest is burnt before replanting
questions.D: animals are grazed inside the forest
questions.explanation: The system reduces the cost of establishing plantations and gives farmers land temporarily.

questions.subject: Agricultural Science
questions.q: Agroforestry is the
questions.A: clearing of forest to make new farmland
questions.B: growing of trees with crops or livestock on the same land
questions.C: hunting of animals living in the forest
questions.D: processing of timber in local sawmills
questions.explanation: Alley cropping and home gardens are agroforestry systems.

questions.subject: Agricultural Science
questions.q: Which of the following is a forest regulation aimed at conservation?
questions.B: creation of forest reserves and licensing of felling
questions.C: free felling of trees by anyone
questions.D: grazing of cattle inside the reserves
questions.explanation: Forest laws control exploitation and protect reserves and endangered species.

questions.subject: Agricultural Science
questions.q: A community that depends on firewood has stripped the surrounding land bare. The most sustainable solution is
questions.A: importing all firewood from other areas
questions.B: establishing community woodlots and fuel-efficient stoves
questions.explanation: Woodlots supply fuel continuously while stoves reduce demand.

questions.subject: Agricultural Science
questions.q: Forests help to regulate the water cycle by
questions.A: increasing surface run-off after heavy rain
questions.B: reducing run-off and increasing infiltration and transpiration
questions.C: stopping rainfall over the surrounding area
questions.D: drying up the rivers and streams in the area
questions.explanation: Forested watersheds give steadier stream flow and less flooding.

questions.subject: Agricultural Science
questions.q: Which of the following is an economic tree of the Nigerian forest zone?
questions.explanation: Iroko, mahogany, obeche and opepe are valuable timber species of the rainforest.
